module: Converter of IES photometric files (a luminaire's light distribution profile) into a PNG "cookie" texture for the editor's SpotLights. The module parses the IES header and data (vertical/horizontal angles, candela, tilt), samples the intensity, generates a square grayscale image (perspective or linear projection, rotation, recentering, edge softening), saves it as PNG and writes a companion `.cookie.json` file (name, photometry, spot angle, lumens, watts, color temperature). The practical entry point is `generateToFile`.
usage:
local ok, info = editor_api_iesImporter.generateToFile("/art/lights/mylamp.ies", "/art/lights/mylamp.color.png", {size = 512, autoCenter = true})
if ok then print(info.metadataPath) end
notes: Angles are in degrees; theta = vertical angle from the axis, phi = horizontal angle, 0-360.

generateCookie options: size (1024), projection "perspective"|"linear" (any other value = error), angle (max half-angle, default min(max vertical angle, 90)), rotate (degrees), centerTheta/centerPhi, edgeFeather (0 = sharp edge).

saveImage options: percentile (100, normalizes by this percentile of the non-zero values), gamma (1), scale (1), invert (false), writeMetadata (false to not write the .cookie.json). Image saved as 8-bit grayscale PNG.
In the companion JSON, `outerAngle` is the FULL spot angle (2 x half-angle, 0.01 to 180) and `innerAngle` is 90% of outerAngle.
parseIES raises error() (to be protected with pcall) if no TILT= line is found or if the data is invalid.
Paths without a leading slash are prefixed with "/" if the file/folder exists that way (normalizePath).
`getPeakDirection` returns 5 values: theta, phi, max candela, horizontal index, vertical index (1-based).

parseHeaderMetadata.desc: Reads the header of an IES file (before the TILT= line): version, [KEY] value entries, `map` table key -> value (keys in uppercase, multiple values joined by \n, [MORE] concatenates to the previous key) and `more` list.

getHeaderValue.desc: Returns the first non-empty header value among a list of keys (case-insensitive).

parseIES.desc: Parses a complete IES file: header, tilt, number of lamps, lumens, candela multiplier, photometric type, units, dimensions, angles and candela[ih][iv] array (multiplied by the multiplier and by the tilt factors if TILT=INCLUDE).

returns.desc: {path, metadata, tilt, verticalAngles, horizontalAngles, candela, numLamps, lumensPerLamp, candelaMultiplier, photometricType, unitsType, width, length, height, ballastFactor, futureUse, inputWatts}

getPeakDirection.desc: Finds the direction of maximum intensity in the IES data.

printIESInfo.desc: Writes an IES summary to the log (number and range of angles, photometric type, watts, candela peak and its direction).

prepareHorizontalData.desc: Sorts the horizontal angles with their candela rows and, if the data covers more than 180° without reaching 360°, adds a 360° row copied from the first one for wrap-around.

sampleIES.desc: Interpolates the intensity (candela) for a direction (theta, phi) taking horizontal symmetry into account. Returns 0 if theta is outside the vertical range or if the data is empty.

prepared.desc: result of prepareHorizontalData (computed if absent; provide it to speed up)

generateCookie.desc: Generates the cookie image: for each pixel of a size x size image, computes the light direction (perspective or linear projection, rotation, basis centered on centerTheta/centerPhi), samples the IES and applies a circular mask (with edgeFeather softening).

opts.desc: {size, projection, rotate, centerTheta, centerPhi, angle, edgeFeather}

returns.desc: {width, height, data (raw values, index y*size+x+1), _ies, generation = {size, angle, projection, rotate, centerTheta, centerPhi, edgeFeather}}

saveImage.desc: Normalizes the image (percentile, scale, gamma, optional inversion), writes it as PNG via GBitmap then, unless writeMetadata == false, writes the companion .cookie.json file.

returns.desc: true if the PNG was written
saveInfo: path, width, height, format, percentile, gamma, scale, invert, maxValue, nonzeroPixels, normalizationValue, metadataWritten, metadataPath

getCookieMetadataPath.desc: Gives the companion file path: replaces `.color.png` or `.png` with `.cookie.json`, otherwise appends `.cookie.json`.

buildCookieMetadata.desc: Builds the metadata table (type "IESLightImport" version 1): source, names (cleaned suggestedObjectName), assets, SpotLight parameters (outerAngle, innerAngle, candela, lumens, watts, color temperature), photometry (peak, lumens, W, lm/W efficacy) and conversion parameters.

writeCookieMetadata.desc: Builds the metadata and writes it to the .cookie.json (jsonWriteFile).

generateToFile.desc: Full pipeline: parses the IES, (autoCenter: centers on the peak), generates the cookie, saves the PNG and the .cookie.json.

opts.desc: {size, angle, projection, rotate, centerTheta, centerPhi, autoCenter, edgeFeather, percentile, gamma, scale, invert, writeMetadata, noInfo}

returns.desc: true if the image is saved

inferCookiePathFromIES.desc: Infers the default output path: same folder and same name as the IES with the `.color.png` extension. Returns "" if the path is empty or ends with /.
